tasks.subject: Task 1: Grammar productions + BNFC regen + parse golden tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Three new BNFC productions (`EUnit`, `TUnit`, `PUnit`), regenerated parser, parse-golden coverage proving `()`, `( )`, and `(   )` parse identically.

**Files:**
- Modify: `grammar/Wok.cf`
- Regenerated: `src-generated/GeneratedParser/Wok/*`
- Create: `test/examples/11-unit.wok`, `test/golden/11-unit.expected`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Grammar contains `EUnit`/`TUnit`/`PUnit` (`"(" ")"` form).
- [ ] BNFC regen runs without conflicts.
- [ ] cabal build succeeds.
- [ ] Three whitespace variants parse identically.
- [ ] No parse-golden regressions.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p parse"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["grammar/Wok.cf", "src-generated/GeneratedParser/Wok/Abs.hs", "test/examples/11-unit.wok", "test/golden/11-unit.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p parse\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["grammar contains EUnit/TUnit/PUnit", "BNFC regen produces no conflicts", "cabal build succeeds", "constructors present in Abs", "three whitespace variants parse identically", "no parse-golden regressions"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Typechecker case branches + typecheck golden tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Hook EUnit/TUnit/PUnit into the typechecker so `()` typechecks as `()`, with golden coverage for value/type/pattern positions and a failure case.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs` (3 case branches)
- Modify: `src/Wok/Reordering.hs` (if needed for exhaustiveness)
- Create: `test/typecheck-examples/11-unit.wok`, `test/typecheck-golden/11-unit.expected`
- Create: `test/typecheck-fail-examples/09-unit-mismatch.wok`, `test/typecheck-fail-golden/09-unit-mismatch.expected`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `inferAtomPat Abs.PUnit` returns `(TCon TcUnit [], [])`.
- [ ] `inferExprW _ Abs.EUnit` returns `TCon TcUnit []`.
- [ ] `translateType _ Abs.TUnit` returns `CTCon TcUnit []`.
- [ ] Success golden passes; fail golden produces Mismatch ... TcInt ... TcUnit.
- [ ] No non-exhaustive-pattern warnings introduced.
- [ ] Entire test suite passes.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20`

**Depends on:** Task 1.
